mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.7% indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity cash flows and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when FEDFUNDS <= 0.7% is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% and housing starts fall below 1600.0 thousand units, it signals a weak labor market and weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when UNRATE > 4.0 and HOUST < 1600.0 is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During recessions (as indicated by negative year-over-year GDP growth) and with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.7%), equity markets experience a rebound due to policy support, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when GDPC1 growth (yoy) < 0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.7% is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1500.0 thousand units) indicate strong demand for housing, which signals a robust economy and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return when HOUST > 1500.0 is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals a weakening supply chain and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when INDPRO < 100.0 is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 255.0, it signals a stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when INDPRO < 100.0 and CPIAUCSL > 255.0 is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) and strong labor force participation (PAYEMS > 150000.0 thousand persons), it signals a labor market recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when UNRATE > 4.5 and PAYEMS > 150000.0 is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
